title: Palo Alto Networks to Buy AI Startup Applied Compute for $4.5 Billion
description: Palo Alto Networks announced its intention to acquire AI infrastructure startup Applied Compute for $4.5 billion in an all-stock deal. The acquisition aims to provide Palo Alto Networks with a platform for fine-tuning and running open-weight AI models in public and sovereign clouds, expanding its AI capabilities beyond traditional security tools. Applied Compute’s technology will be integrated into Palo Alto Networks’ offerings, with deployment options in various cloud environments. The deal is expected to close in fiscal Q3 2027, pending regulatory approval. There is no indication of a security vulnerability or threat associated with this acquisition.
